title: Week 18 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “financial resilience”?
options: A specific, measurable, time-bound outcome involving money or resources.
A cost that changes with use, price, or choice.
A debt instrument promising specified payments subject to issuer risk.
Capacity to absorb shocks and continue meeting essential obligations.
questions.explanation: Financial resilience means capacity to absorb shocks and continue meeting essential obligations.

The value of the best alternative forgone.

A fraud targeting prior victims with promises to recover lost money for a fee.

A condition or event not covered by a policy.
